name: butler-app-checkout
title_zh: 云手机里替你点完 GrabFood
tagline_zh: 外卖、打车、登录都能在云端安卓机上跑，验证码发到你自己手机号；下单前设一个检查点，金额和地址你点头才付。
tagline_en: Runs food delivery, rides and logins on a cloud Android phone. SMS codes go to your own number, and it stops at a.
desc_en: Order, book or sign in inside a phone app — GrabFood, Grab, foodpanda — on a cloud Android phone: SMS codes on your own number, a checkpoint before paying.
why_zh: 验证码走你自己的号，不是虚拟号；付款前强制停一次，把订单摊开给你看。
why_en: SMS codes land on your real number, not a rented one, and it hard-stops before payment to show you the order.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 GrabFood、Grab、foodpanda 这类手机 App 内下单；需要一台已登录的云安卓机。
limit_en: Only in-app ordering for GrabFood, Grab and foodpanda; needs an already-logged-in cloud Android phone, no web or other apps.
title_en: Orders GrabFood on a cloud Android phone, pausing before.
